tools.name: plot_trip
tools.description: Creates a road trip on Stopful, or updates one plotted earlier, and returns an interactive map of it — adding, removing, reordering or renaming stops, changing nights, dates or party size, and redrawing the route. Renders a multi-stop driving route as an interactive map and returns a link to it, plu

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "plot_trip" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Renders a multi-stop driving route as an interactive map on Stopful and returns a link to it, plus an inline map in clients that support one.
